en.headline: Hong Kong August exports rise 53 percent, second highest on record
en.dek: The value of total exports reached HK$667.9 billion, driven by strong demand for AI-related electronic products, while imports climbed 60 percent.
body: Hong Kong’s total exports of goods rose 53 percent year-on-year to HK$667.9 billion in August, the second-highest monthly figure on record after July, according to provisional figures from the Census and Statistics Department.

Imports increased 60 percent to HK$739.1 billion, resulting in a visible trade deficit of HK$71.2 billion, or 9.6 percent of the value of imports. For the first eight months of the year, exports were up 42.5 percent and imports up 43.2 percent.

Exports to Asia rose 59.2 percent, with particularly strong growth to Malaysia, Vietnam, Singapore and the mainland. Shipments to the United States and Mexico also recorded solid gains. Growth was led by electrical machinery and parts, and office machines and automatic data processing machines.

A government spokesman said sustained global demand for AI-related electronic products continued to support merchandise trade performance, but external uncertainties including geopolitical tensions and protectionist measures warranted close attention.

zh.headline: 本港8月出口升53% 連升30個月 進口急升60%
zh.dek: 整體出口貨值達6679億元，為有紀錄以來第二高，受人工智能相關電子產品需求帶動；進口升60%。
body: 政府統計處公布，8月本港整體出口貨值按年上升53%至6679億元，連升30個月，升幅較7月擴大，是有紀錄以來第二高水平；進口貨值上升60%至7391億元，錄得有形貿易逆差712億元。
今年首8個月整體出口貨值按年上升42.5%，進口貨值上升43.2%，期內有形貿易逆差3712億元。
輸往亞洲的整體出口貨值上升59.2%，輸往內地、美國、新加坡及越南等主要目的地均錄得顯著升幅。主要增長類別包括電動機械、儀器和用具及零件，以及辦公室機器和自動資料處理機器。
政府發言人表示，受人工智能相關電子產品強勁需求帶動，商品出口繼續飆升，短期內預計繼續支持貿易表現，但外圍環境包括地緣政治及保護主義措施仍充滿不確定性，須密切關注。
